info.description: ElevenLabs Speech to Speech model for voice agents. One model id bundles speech recognition, turn-taking, an LLM and text to speech, tuned as one cascaded system, with 90+ languages and tool calling. It is the default and lowest-latency, lowest-cost Realtime model. Use it in ElevenAgents or through the OpenAI-compatible Realtime API over WebSocket. Realtime models are rolling out gradually across workspaces, and Mini is not available under Zero Retention Mode or HIPAA. The API price is $0.08 per minute of connected audio plus LLM usage at $0.20 per 1M input tokens and $6.00 per 1M output tokens. The stored price is the per-minute rate.

zh.description: ElevenLabs 面向语音智能体的语音到语音模型。一个模型 ID 打包了语音识别、轮次切换、LLM 和文本转语音，作为一个级联系统整体调优，支持 90 多种语言和工具调用。它是默认的 Realtime 模型，延迟和成本最低。可在 ElevenAgents 中使用，或通过兼容 OpenAI 的 Realtime API（WebSocket）调用。Realtime 模型正在各工作区逐步开放，Mini 不支持零保留模式（Zero Retention Mode）或 HIPAA。API 价格为每分钟连接音频 $0.08，另加 LLM 用量：每 1M 输入 token $0.20、每 1M 输出 token $6.00。记录的是按分钟计费的价格。
